events.title: 雲端存檔開啟公告
events.summary: A recent update has added Steam Cloud save support. If you have played the game on a different computer or with an older version, a Steam Cloud sync conflict may appear when launching the game for the first time.If this happens, please make sure to select the newer local save file to avoid having your current progress overwritten by an older cloud save.Important: We strongly recommend backing up the Save files in the game folder before updating.
